name: MK-212
summary: MK-212, also known as 6-chloro-2-(1-piperazinyl)pyrazine (CPP), is a serotonin receptor agonist of the arylpiperazine family. It is specifically described as a non-selective serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist or as a "relatively selective serotonin 5-HT2C receptor full agonist. The drug promotes the secretion of serum prolactin and cortisol in humans.

pharmacology.text: MK-212 is an agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2 receptors, including the serotonin 5-HT2C, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2A receptors, in that order of potency. It is a full agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2C receptor, a moderate-efficacy partial agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2B receptor, and a partial to full agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor.
